verdict.rationale: LLM-driven, selector-free extraction is a fair question for a web-scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows an LLM reading a page and choosing which structured fields to extract. The cited material covers Actors, SDKs, proxies, an MCP server that lets agents call Actors, and conventional scraping libraries (Playwright, Puppeteer, Crawlee), none of which is about AI extraction itself.
